name: The Purple Comet
bio: Purple suit, gold trim, no powers to speak of. Shows up anyway.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-11 ("Superhero", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs).
